about_the_game:
Forget mercy. Forget salvation. There is nothing here but blood, steel, and light from cannons.

In a world where ancient Slavic rites are intertwined with the ashes of future technology, you are the last warrior of the Varangian Guard. Against you are hordes of cyber-mutants, obsessed cultists and traitors who have sold their flesh and faith for the power of a dark cult. In the style of Slavic Gothic.

  • A real boomer-shooter - old-school gameplay in the spirit of DOOM II, Duke Nukem and Quake. No cover, no reloading. Just you and your speed.

  • Cult tech - an arsenal ranging from axes and archaic shotguns to and damn futuristic cannons.

  • Grimdark universe - a mix of Slavic gothic and techno-cult.

  • Grim enemies - from cultists, magi, sagittarians to cybernatchers.

  • Grim locations - forgotten kapisches, industrial necropolises, ancient citadels and throne halls.

  • Soundtrack - True Metal

content_descriptors.notes: The game showcases pixelated blood, with enemies getting bloody wounds.

short_description: Old-school boomer shooter in a world where Slavic myths have merged with technocult. Cut, shoot and survive among cultists, cyber-mutants and traitors in armor. Restore the glory of the Varangian Guard - through blood, steel and ancient wrath.
